items:
Home Highlights:
- Gulf Front Home w/ Private Beach
- Private heated resort style pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $80 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- Three Complimentary beach setups included - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31
- Elevator
- Chefs Kitchen & Multiple Large Entertaining Spaces
- 6 Adult Bikes Included
- 6 seater Golf Cart included

Located directly on the Gulf in Seagrove Beach, this Gulf-front luxury residence offers an unparalleled coastal setting with private, attached beach access leading straight from the pool deck to the pristine sugar-white sands. Designed for guests who value privacy, elegance, and effortless beachfront living, the home delivers a refined 30A experience from arrival to departure.
Outdoor living is elevated with a resort-style private pool and spa,, complemented by multiple expansive terraces ideal for lounging and entertaining. Three complimentary seasonal beach setups enhance your time on the shoreline, creating a seamless transition from sophisticated outdoor spaces to the water’s edge.
Inside, more than 4,500 square feet of beautifully curated living space features a chef’s kitchen, generous entertaining areas, and multiple private suites designed for comfort and discretion. The Gulf-view primary suite offers a serene retreat with its own private outdoor living space, perfectly positioned for sunrise mornings and sunset evenings.
An elevator provides convenient access to all levels, while six adult bikes and a six-seat golf cart allow for effortless exploration of the surrounding 30A area, completing a stay defined by luxury, exclusivity, and true Gulf-front living.

Sleeping Arrangements
First Floor
- Full Bedroom w/ Full XL Loft Bed and Full XL over Full XL Bunk w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo

Second Floor
- King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
- King Bedroom w/ Full over Full Bunk, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Separate
- Half Bathroom

Third Floor
- Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Separate
- King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
- Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
